AddElement.description: Adds an element to the current paragraph.

params.description: The document element which will be added at the current position. Returns false if theoElement type is not supported by a paragraph.
params.name: oElement

params.description: The position where the current element will be added. If this value is notspecified, then the element will be added at the end of the current paragraph.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: Returns `false` if the type of `oElement` is not supported by paragraphcontent.

AddLineBreak.description: Adds a line break to the current position and starts the next element from a new line.

AddTabStop.description: Adds a tab stop to the current paragraph.

AddText.description: Adds some text to the current paragraph.

params.description: The text that we want to insert into the current document element. It can be a string or an array of Unicode code points.
params.name: text

params.description: An array of character widths (in millimeters). It should be the same length as the array of code points passed in the "text" parameter. When the widths are specified, the characters are added preserving these exact widths.
params.name: widths

AddText.signature: AddText(text: string | number[], widths?: number[]): ApiRun

Copy.description: Creates a paragraph copy. Ingnore comments, footnote references, complex fields.

returns.description: returns false if paragraph haven't parent.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiParagraph class.

GetElement.description: Returns a paragraph element using the position specified.

params.description: The position where the element which content we want to get must be located.
params.name: nPos

GetElementsCount.description: Returns a number of elements in the current paragraph.

GetFontNames.description: Returns all font names from all elements inside the current paragraph.

returns.description: The font names used for the current paragraph.

GetIndFirstLine.description: Returns the paragraph first line indentation.

returns.description: The paragraph first line indentation value measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

GetIndLeft.description: Returns the paragraph left side indentation.

returns.description: The paragraph left side indentation value measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

GetIndRight.description: Returns the paragraph right side indentation.

returns.description: The paragraph right side indentation value measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

GetInternalId.description: Returns an internal ID of the current paragraph.

GetLastRunWithText.description: Returns the last Run with text in the current paragraph.

returns.description: returns null if paragraph is last.

GetOutlineLvl.description: Returns the outline level of the specified properties.

returns.description: returns null if paragraph is first.

GetSpacingAfter.description: Returns the spacing after value of the current paragraph.

returns.description: The value of the spacing after the current paragraph measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

GetSpacingBefore.description: Returns the spacing before value of the current paragraph.

returns.description: The value of the spacing before the current paragraph measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

GetSpacingLineRule.description: Returns the paragraph line spacing rule.

GetSpacingLineValue.description: Returns the paragraph line spacing value.

returns.description: to know is twips or line240 use ApiParaPr.prototype.GetSpacingLineRule().

GetTabs.description: Returns the custom tab stops of the current paragraph.

params.description: Options for formatting the returned text.
params.name: options

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include numbering or not.
params.name: options_Numbering

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include mathematical expressions or not.
params.name: options_Math

params.description: Defines how the line separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any string can be used. The default separator is "\r".
params.name: options_NewLineSeparator

params.description: Defines how the tab will be specified in the resulting string (does not apply to numbering). Any string can be used. The default symbol is "\t".
params.name: options_TabSymbol

GetText.signature: GetText(options?: object, options_Numbering?: boolean, options_Math?: boolean, options_NewLineSeparator?: string, options_TabSymbol?: string): string

InsertParagraph.description: Inserts a paragraph at the specified position.

params.description: Text or paragraph.
params.name: paragraph

params.description: The position where the text or paragraph will be inserted ("before" or "after" the paragraph specified).
params.name: sPosition

params.description: Defines if this method returns a new paragraph (true) or the current paragraph (false).
params.name: beRNewPara

returns.description: returns null if param paragraph is invalid.

InsertParagraph.signature: InsertParagraph(paragraph: string | ApiParagraph, sPosition: string, beRNewPara: boolean): ApiParagraph | null

IsEmpty.description: Returns true if the paragraph has no content elements (only the paragraph end mark).

Last.description: Returns the last element of the paragraph.

Push.description: Adds an element to the current paragraph.

params.description: The document element which will be added at the current position. Returns false if theoElement type is not supported by a paragraph.
params.name: oElement

returns.description: Returns `false` if the type of `oElement` is not supported by paragraphcontent.

RemoveAllElements.description:
Removes all the elements from the current paragraph.
<note>When all the elements are removed from the paragraph, a new empty run is automatically created. If you want to add
content to this run, use the {@link ApiParagraph#GetElement} method.</note>

RemoveElement.description:
Removes an element using the position specified.
<note>If the element you remove is the last paragraph element (i.e. all the elements are removed from the paragraph),
a new empty run is automatically created. If you want to add
content to this run, use the {@link ApiParagraph#GetElement} method.</note>

params.description: The element position which we want to remove from the paragraph.
params.name: nPos

SetBold.description: Sets the bold property to the text character.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed bold.
params.name: isBold

returns.description: this

SetBullet.description: Sets the bullet or numbering to the current paragraph.

params.description: The bullet object created with the {@link Api#CreateBullet} or {@link Api#CreateNumbering} method.
params.name: oBullet

SetCaps.description: Specifies that any lowercase characters in this paragraph are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current paragraph are displayed capitalized.
params.name: isCaps

returns.description: this

SetDoubleStrikeout.description: Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current paragraph are displayed double struck through.
params.name: isDoubleStrikeout

returns.description: this

SetFontFamily.description: Sets all 4 font slots with the specified font family.

params.description: The font family or families used for the current paragraph.
params.name: sFontFamily

returns.description: this

SetFontSize.description: Sets the font size to the characters of the current paragraph.

params.description: The text size value measured in half-points (1/144 of an inch).
params.name: nSize

returns.description: this

SetHighlight.description: Specifies a highlighting color which is applied as a background to the contents of the current paragraph.

params.description: Available highlight color.
params.name: sColor

returns.description: this

SetIndFirstLine.description: Sets the paragraph first line indentation.

params.description: The paragraph first line indentation value measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

SetIndLeft.description: Sets the paragraph left side indentation.

params.description: The paragraph left side indentation value measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

SetIndRight.description: Sets the paragraph right side indentation.

params.description: The paragraph right side indentation value measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

SetItalic.description: Sets the italic property to the text character.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current paragraph are displayed italicized.
params.name: isItalic

returns.description: this

params.description: The justification type thatwill be applied to the paragraph contents.
params.name: sJc

SetOutlineLvl.description: Sets the outline level for the specified properties.

params.description: The outline level. Possible values: 1-9. The 1The desired functionality is as follows: When inserting document A into document B using the merge document API during editing, the source of document A should be visible within document B. By clicking or hovering over the inserted content of document A in document B, information about the insertion of document A should be displayed in a pop-up/floating window, preserving the boundaries of document A. Document A should be able to be inserted between any two characters in document B.To set no outline level, use this method without a parameter.
params.name: lvl

SetSmallCaps.description:
Specifies that all the small letter characters in this paragraph are formatted for display only as their capital
letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current paragraph are displayed capitalized two points smaller or not.
params.name: isSmallCaps

returns.description: this

SetSpacing.description: Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.

params.description: The value of the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nSpacing

returns.description: this

SetSpacingAfter.description:
Sets the spacing after the current paragraph. If the value of the isAfterAuto parameter is true, then 
any value of the nAfter is ignored. If isAfterAuto parameter is not specified, then it 
will be interpreted as false.

params.description: The value of the spacing after the current paragraph measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nAfter

params.description: The true value disables the spacing after the current paragraph.
params.name: isAfterAuto

SetSpacingBefore.description:
Sets the spacing before the current paragraph. If the value of the isBeforeAuto parameter is true, then 
any value of the nBefore is ignored. If isBeforeAuto parameter is not specified, then 
it will be interpreted as false.

params.description: The value of the spacing before the current paragraph measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nBefore

params.description: The true value disables the spacing before the current paragraph.
params.name: isBeforeAuto

SetSpacingLine.description:
Sets the paragraph line spacing. If the value of the sLineRule parameter is either 
"atLeast" or "exact", then the value of nLine will be interpreted as twentieths of a point. If 
the value of the sLineRule parameter is "auto", then the value of the 
nLine parameter will be interpreted as 240ths of a line.

params.description: The line spacing value measured either in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch) or in 240ths of a line.
params.name: nLine

params.description: The rule that determines the measuring units of the line spacing.
params.name: sLineRule

SetStrikeout.description: Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed with a single horizontal line through the center of the line.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current paragraph are displayed struck through.
params.name: isStrikeout

returns.description: this

SetTabs.description:
Specifies a sequence of custom tab stops which will be used for any tab characters in the current paragraph.
**Warning**: The lengths of aPos array and aVal array **MUST BE** equal to each other.

params.description: An array of the positions of custom tab stops with respect to the current page marginsmeasured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: aPos

params.description: An array of the styles of custom tab stops, which determines the behavior of the tabstop and the alignment which will be applied to text entered at the current custom tab stop.
params.name: aVal

SetText.description: Replaces the paragraph content with the specified text.

params.description: The text to set.
params.name: text

params.description: The paragraph text properties.
params.name: oTextPr

returns.description: returns false if param is invalid.

SetUnderline.description:
Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character
(less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current paragraph are displayed underlined.
params.name: isUnderline

returns.description: this

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiParagraph object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used numberings will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteNumberings

params.description: Specifies if the used styles will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteStyles
